metaTitle: Sliding Glass Door Repair Sunrise FL | Condo Sliders
description: Sliding glass door repair in Sunrise for condo owners: doors that take two hands to open, locks that won't catch, closet sliders, and who handles what.
h1: Sliding glass door repair in Sunrise
subline: From balcony sliders that fight you to mirrored closet doors, here's how a Sunrise condo owner sorts out repair, responsibility and permits.
answer: Sliding glass door repair in Sunrise often happens in condo units, where the declaration of condominium decides who is responsible for exterior doors. A door that takes two hands to open usually needs new rollers and a cleaned track. A lock that won't catch often just needs the panel raised back into line.
faqHeading: Sunrise condo and home slider questions
closing: Send us a photo of the door and what it's doing, or give us a call, and we'll tell you what we think is wrong before anyone comes out.

faqs.q: Can I get a door permit at the Sunrise Building Division without an appointment?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. The Building Division lists windows, doors and shutters among the structural items accepted at walk-through permitting on Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 8:00 to 10:00 AM. Call (954) 572-2354 first, since walk-in hours can change.

faqs.q: My condo board has hurricane protection specs. Does a new slider have to follow them?
faqs.a: Plan on it. Florida law requires condo boards to adopt hurricane protection specifications that comply with the building code. Where approval is required, the board can't refuse an owner's hurricane protection that conforms to those specifications, so get a copy before choosing a door.

faqs.q: Can a sliding door be made easier to open for an older parent?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. A heavy door usually has worn rollers or a dirty track, and new rollers with a cleaned, adjusted track can bring it back to a one-hand push. A handle with an easier lever may also fit the existing holes.

faqs.q: Can the closet doors and the balcony slider be fixed in the same visit?
faqs.a: Yes, tell us about both when you call. Mirrored closet doors use different, smaller rollers and guides than a patio slider, so a photo of each door helps us bring parts that fit both.

faqs.q: What should I photograph before calling about a condo slider in Sunrise?
faqs.a: Take a photo of the whole door, the label etched in a glass corner or on the frame edge, the handle, and the bottom of the panel where it meets the track. Those four pictures usually show the brand, the hardware and where it's failing.
